personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with Dark-First Utility elements for Dark Mode
personality_one_liner: A clinical yet highly advanced biohacking dashboard combining the approachable clarity of Apple Health with the tactical precision of a 14-day telemetry command center.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room and grouped cards similar to Apple Health.

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to give an Apple Health feel.
Apply glass effects on modal scrims.
dont's: Do not use glass on standard dashboard cards or form inputs.

screens.name: Today (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: A live command center displaying biometric protocol, readiness ring, stress interdiction, and the chrono-nutrition timeline.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for ring and timeline cards.
states.error: Failed to sync with Health Connect. 'Retry Sync' CTA.

screens.layout: Top Hero: Google Fit style large Circular Readiness Ring (0-100) using 'brandPrimary' (Emerald) with tabular monospace readout in the center. Below the ring, delta tags for HRV, Sleep, Strain in small pill badges. Middle Section: Acute Stress Interdiction banner (distinct background, calls up Breath Pacer modal). Bottom Section: 'Today's Chrono-Stack' timeline. Each timeline entry is a card with cyan accents ('brandSecondary'), showing product dose, time, and quick check-off. Use generous whitespace (lg/xl margins) around cards to mimic Apple Health.

screens.name: Stash
screens.purpose: Manage supplement inventory, view chemical-form quality badges, and add new items via scanner.

states.empty: Empty shelf illustration. 'Add First Supplement' CTA.

screens.layout: Grid or list view. Cards display the supplement name, stock counters (e.g., '30 caps left'), and prominent chemical-form quality badges (green for Optimal, yellow/grey for Low Bioavailability). A floating action button (FAB) for adding new items or snapping a label via the Camera Scanner modal.

screens.name: Trends
screens.purpose: N=1 Biometric Correlation interactive charts overlaying supplement intake with HRV and Sleep data.

states.loading: Faded graph lines with loading spinner.
states.empty: Not enough data yet. Requires 14 days of telemetry.

screens.layout: Apple Health style interactive charts spanning the full width of the card. A segmented control at the top to toggle between HRV and Deep Sleep. The graph uses the brand palette (Emerald/Cyan) against the Slate surface, with clear intake markers indicating when protocols were consumed.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure region, theme, AI provider, API keys, and manage Health Connect permissions.
screens.layout: Standard grouped list layout (like iOS Settings). Categories for 'Account & Region', 'Theme' (Dark/Light/System), 'AI Configuration' (Provider, API Key), and 'Telemetry & Permissions' (Health Connect toggles, Simulator presets).

readiness_ring.style: SVG circular progress. Background track uses surfaceTertiary. Active track uses brandPrimary (Emerald). Center text is an oversized Mono font (3xl or 4xl) for a clinical look.

chrono_timeline_card.style: surfaceSecondary card with a border left accent of brandSecondary (Cyan). Check-off button on the right.

quality_badge.style: Pill-shaped, surfaceTertiary background with solid text/icon for optimal forms. Warning colors for low bioavailability.

breath_pacer_modal.style: Full screen overlay with heavy blur (expo-blur). Central expanding/contracting circle animation using reanimated, guiding a 2-min cyclic sigh.

stash_empty_state.alt: A white plastic supplement bottle acting as stash placeholder

readiness_hero_bg.alt: Abstract glowing green fitness ring background for dark mode

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce the dual-theme requirement: Slate-950 canvas/Slate-900 cards in Dark, Slate-50 canvas/White cards in Light. Ensure the Readiness ring is Emerald-400 (Dark) / Emerald-600 (Light) and Timeline accents are Cyan-400 (Dark) / Cyan-600 (Light).
Use 'Geist-Regular' for text and 'GeistMono-Regular' for numeric readouts, large data displays, and the Readiness Ring score, simulating tabular figures.
Component Spacing: Emulate Apple Health and Google Fit by using grouped cards with 'lg' or 'xl' padding. Do not let cards stretch edge-to-edge; they should sit inside a padded scroll view.
Stress Interdiction: Implement a standalone modal component for the 2-min Breath Pacer using Reanimated for smooth expanding/contracting visuals.
Timeline Check-offs: Provide subtle haptic feedback (using expo-haptics) when a chrono-nutrition dose is marked as consumed.
No Tailwind or NativeWind. Build components using React Native StyleSheet referencing the color hexes and numeric padding tokens directly.
